system.name: LoKU (Low-rank Knowledge Unlearning)
system.one_liner: LLM unlearning with an Inverted Hinge Loss (IHL) instead of gradient ascent and a Fisher-weighted LoRA initialization (FILA) for robust, parameter-efficient forgetting.

content.variant_note: two baseline-versus-proposed pairs (GA vs IHL loss boxes side by side, default vs FILA LoRA initialisation stacked) next to a small set-up illustration on one grey board
content.argues: Unlike gradient ascent, IHL lowers only the unwanted token and lifts the next likely one; FILA puts the weights that matter for the forget data into LoRA adapters first.
content.subject: A grey board with the unlearning set-up, a token-probability comparison of two losses on one query, and two LoRA initialisations drawn on the same weight blocks.

lessons.what_to_learn: Contrast two objectives in two identical white boxes: the same candidate tokens with down, up or dash marks and the loss formula underneath. Keep one colour (orange) for everything tied to the forget data so that a weight matrix can visibly split into a frozen blue part and trainable orange adapters.
lessons.suits: Training-objective or initialisation contributions in LLM papers that can be explained on one toy query and a weight-matrix sketch.

evidence: LLM unlearning aims to forget data points in Df while maintaining knowledge of the retain set Dr.
IHL, which replaces each unwanted token with the next most-probable one
FILA extracts and places parameters important in generating Df to LoRA weights a priori via weighted low-rank approximation.

summary: LoKU (Low-rank Knowledge Unlearning) makes LLM unlearning robust and parameter-efficient with two parts: the Inverted Hinge Loss (IHL) and a Fisher-weighted LoRA initialization (FILA). Figure 1 is one grey board in four titled zones. Top left sets the task: a dataset cylinder split into retain (blue) and forget (orange) sets, and a pretrained robot that becomes an unlearned robot after a user says 'Please remove my data!'. Bottom left compares gradient ascent and IHL on the query 'Did you put your name in the Goblet of Fire, ____': candidate tokens carry red-down, green-up or dash marks, with the loss formula beneath. The right column contrasts default LoRA initialization (B = 0, A random, grey) with FILA, which splits W into a frozen blue part and orange trainable B* and A*, marked with snowflake and flame icons.
summary_zh: LoKU 用倒置合页损失（IHL）和 Fisher 加权 LoRA 初始化（FILA）实现稳健省参的大模型遗忘。图 1 灰色底板分四区：遗忘任务设定、GA 与 IHL 的词概率对比、默认与 FILA 初始化对比，雪花与火焰标冻结和可训练。
notes: The prior pass put contribution-mosaic first and stage-pipeline last; side-by-side-contrast is primary here because two of the three zones are baseline-versus-proposed pairs, and stage-pipeline is dropped (the dataset to pretrained to unlearned chain has only three items). The meaning of 'or' as the next most likely token and of greyed Neo and 42 as unlikely tokens is read from the paper's description of IHL, not from labels. The orange-versus-blue reading of the weight gradient is inferred by colour matching; the figure has no legend.
